series: Climate Fiscal Policy Briefs · Section 4: Sovereign Incentives · October 2026
title: Reward Governments, Not Projects

slides.title: Reward Governments, Not Projects
slides.subtitle: International incentives for national climate policy: section 4 in ten slides
slides.message: Cash on the scale needed will not be voted. Pay instead in what the international system holds cheaply and governments value highly: balance-sheet strength, as guarantees on green borrowing, held by a trust and earned by policy.
slides.author: Stephen J. Stretton · writing in a personal capacity
